uncertain: PDF page index assumes one OpenAIR cover page before the paper (printed p.6 = PDF p.7) (Table 1)
No SMOTE in baselines; rows give OBU BA with smote=null and best_other from kmeans/Org BA (Table 1, p.7)
Metric BA chosen because no G-mean/AUC/F1/accuracy reported; Sensitivity also available (Table 1, p.7)
Bold/italic marks in Table 1 not captured from text extraction; table not rendered as image (p.7)
Group labels inferred from blank-line blocks in Table 1 matched to the 4 groups described in Sec. 4.2 (p.7-8)
source_repo per dataset not stated; paper only says 'UCI and KEEL repositories' collectively (p.6, Sec. 3.2)
how_obtained inferred from KEEL-style names; Haberman/Pima marked original (p.6)
Text says size range 129 to 5472 but max in Table 1 is 4174 (Abalone19); IR range 1.87 to 129.44 but Glass1 printed 1.82 (p.6 vs Table 1)
notes: OBU = Overlap-Based Undersampling with Fuzzy C-means (C=2), alpha-cut 0.45 (tested 0.3,0.36,0.42,0.45,0.5). Undersampling method, not an oversampler; no SMOTE comparison. Table 1 also gives nMajLeft (majority instances left after OBU) and Sens for each method. Dataset names copied as printed incl. typo 'Segmemt0'. Code: https://github.com/fonkafon/Overlap_based_Undersampling (as printed, not fetched). IDEAL 2018, LNCS 11341, pp. 689-697.
